seo.seo_title: Websites for businesses in Boden | Norden Media UF
seo.seo_description: We build websites that get found on Google and win more customers, and handle domain, email and hosting. Fixed price, and you only pay when you are happy.

hero.t1: Local media agency in the north
hero.t2: You are good at what you do.
hero.t4: We build websites that show who you are, get found on Google and bring in more customers. Clear, reliable and at a fixed price.

pay_when_you_are_happy.t11: You only pay when you are happy.

before_and_after.t22: It is old, hard to update, or there is no website at all yet.
before_and_after.t24: Customers search online, but you are not always the one who shows up first.
before_and_after.t26: Visitors look around but do not get in touch, and business is lost.
before_and_after.t27: Little time for the digital side.
before_and_after.t28: Website, email and bookings take time from what you really want to do.
before_and_after.t29: Sound familiar? Then we can help.

who_we_are.t37: Norden Media UF is run by three students on the Technology Programme, specialising in information and media technology, at Björknäsgymnasiet in Boden. We work in a structured way, communicate clearly and take responsibility for every delivery, from the first call to ongoing management.
who_we_are.t39_alt: The team behind Norden Media UF: three people in black t-shirts in front of a light wall

what_we_do.t42: From the first sketch to day-to-day operations. You get a finished solution.
what_we_do.t44: Responsive design, fast loading and a web system with booking, forms and login when needed.
what_we_do.t46: Technical SEO, structured data, a Google Business Profile and content optimised for AI answers.
what_we_do.t48: Online booking linked to a customer register, with automatic confirmations, reminders and mailings.
what_we_do.t49: Your own domain and business email
what_we_do.t50: We register the domain, manage DNS and set up email with your company name.
what_we_do.t52: Hosting, SSL, backups and updates are included, so everything keeps running.

how_it_works.t56: You tell us what you need, and we take care of the rest. It usually takes three to six weeks from the first call to launch.
how_it_works.t59: We get to know your business, your customers and how you work today.
how_it_works.t61: You get a fixed price for the build and a clear monthly fee, with what is included. Based on what you want, you get a short form about the content to fill in. After launch you can always change all the content yourselves, easily through your customer portal.
how_it_works.t63: We write the copy, build the website on a test address that only you can see and connect the systems. You can follow the work all the way.
how_it_works.t65: You review and approve the website. Then we move your web address and email and publish it, so you show up on Google from day one.
how_it_works.t67: We keep the website running, secure and up to date, and help you whenever something needs changing. With the Sarek and Kebne packages you also get a monthly report with suggested improvements.

after_the_uf_year.t71: A UF student company runs for one school year, but working with us does not have to end there. Our plan is to continue the business as a limited company, with the same people and the same service, for every client who wants to stay.
after_the_uf_year.t72: The website and all its content belong to you.
after_the_uf_year.t73: If you would rather run it yourselves, we show you how everything works and hand over all the material. If you need changes later on, we are still here to help at an hourly rate.

we_also_stream_live.t77: We stream conferences, lectures and events with multiple cameras, clear sound and graphics, straight to your website and social media.
we_also_stream_live.t84_alt: Audience at an event at Boden Business Park, with a speaker on stage and a presentation on a large screen
we_also_stream_live.t86_alt: Video camera with a monitor filming a conversation on stage

faq.t90: You pay a fixed start-up cost for the build itself, from SEK 5,495, then a monthly fee from SEK 195 for hosting, updates and support. As a UF student company we do not charge VAT, so the prices are what you pay. Live streaming is quoted per event.
faq.t93: Only when the website is finished and you are happy with it. The start-up cost is invoiced once you have approved the finished website, and the monthly fee starts when the website goes live.
faq.t94: What happens when the UF year ends?
faq.t95: Our plan is to continue the business as a limited company, with the same people and the same service, for the clients who want to stay. The website and its content belong to you. If you would rather run it yourselves, we show you how everything works and hand over all the material, and if you need changes later on we help at an hourly rate.
faq.t97: Usually three to six weeks from the first call to launch, depending on the size of the website and how quickly we receive material from you.
faq.t99: Do we need to know anything about tech?
faq.t100: No. You tell us what you want and we handle the rest. Everything is explained in plain language.
faq.t101: We have no website at all. Is that a problem?
faq.t102: Not at all. We start from scratch and take care of everything, from domain and email to a finished website that shows up on Google.
faq.t103: Can you take over our old website, domain and email?
faq.t104: Yes. We move your domain, DNS and email for you and plan the move so that you lose neither email nor your rankings on Google.
faq.t107: More and more people search using AI services such as ChatGPT and Google's AI Overviews. We structure the content on your website so that these services understand what you offer and can point customers to you.
